title: Meet the Nyborgs
author: Blitzwing (Tank Designer-Developer)
body: A design and mockup for the characters Nye calls Nyborgs. Each one is a little round head with two dot eyes and 2–4 chunky strands of yarn for hair, in a color you pick (red, blue, yellow and a few close shades), and you can add glasses or a hat. They start as simple 2D loops: a calm idle and a bouncy move that mirrors when the Nyborg turns. One Nyborg can train in any arena, riding a tank or driving a car. Its look is cosmetic only, so no match or training result changes.
next: Nye's call on accessories, upgrades and names, then the art pipeline and a Customize preview.
